annotations.text:
CALM, NOT CLEVER.

The last pass was a poster: grain, mis-registration, art-school type. Impressive once, tiring at the fortieth open. This is the same two-column waterfall, designed to disappear.

One typeface. One accent colour. No shadows — depth is the white card on the warm ground, nothing more. Everything else is spacing.

THE ONE SIGNATURE, and it is quiet: the interest is a coloured WORD under each card — not a chip, not a badge, not a stamp.

It colour-codes the whole feed so the eye can sort it while scrolling, and it costs no space and makes no noise. That is the entire visual identity, and it is enough.

Legibility, since that was the point:

· Card titles 13.5px semibold at 18px line height — readable at arm's length, two lines before truncation.
· Body 14px / 21px on the post. Meta never below 11.5px.
· Tab labels 10.5px, always paired with an icon, never the only cue.
· Every tap target is at least 44px tall, including the compose button and the tab items.
· Type scales with the platform font setting; nothing is a fixed-height box around text.
